caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical glass placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The glass has a transparent upper section adorned with intricate white floral and leaf patterns, while the lower section is an opaque blue. Decorative gold-colored lines and accents separate the blue area from the clear portion above. The glass is outlined with fine black lines, and there is a rectangular border placed behind the glass, also drawn in a thin black line. There is a small, handwritten signature and date near the bottom right edge of the glass. The entire composition maintains a focus on the central glass, with no other objects or additional details present.
title: Tumbler
